meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能调用 dial 命令向真实手机号发送短信、拨打 AI 语音电话，还能等待并读取收到的短信验证码。遇到没见过的 dial 子命令，它会先运行帮助再执行。
howto.when: 当用户提到短信、电话、验证码等，或要求发短信、打电话、收码时触发；首次运行 dial 前、或询问 Dial 平台功能时也会触发。

say.text: 给 +14155550123 发条短信：明天下午三点见。
say.note: 短信会发送到那个号码。

say.text: 拨打 +14155550123，让 AI 语音问对方是否方便接听。
say.note: Claude 会拨打该号码，由 AI 语音代理与对方对话。

say.text: 等一条发到我们号码的短信验证码，来了读给我听。
say.note: Claude 会监听入站短信，收到后读出验证码。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the `dial` CLI to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and wait for inbound texts/codes on a real number. For a new `dial` subcommand it first reads its `--help`.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions SMS, calls, or codes; asks to text/call someone or wait for a code; before the first `dial` command in a session; or when exploring the Dial platform.

say_en.text: Send an SMS to +14155550123: see you tomorrow at 3pm.
say_en.note: The SMS is sent to that number.

say_en.text: Call +14155550123; the AI agent asks if they are free to talk.
say_en.note: Claude places a call handled by the AI voice agent.

say_en.text: Wait for the SMS code sent to our number and read it out.
say_en.note: Claude long-polls for the inbound SMS then shows the code.
